note: DEVELOPMENT set for remediation calibration. Original Northstar scenarios, authored for tuning investigator-v2. These are deliberately separate from the held-out golden set in investigation_cases.json and must never be merged into it — iterating on the held-out cases would destroy their value as a measurement. Expected outcomes are in dev_remediation_labels.json.

tickets.title: Whole team locked out of the console
tickets.description: Sign-in through our identity provider fails for everyone since around 09:00. It worked yesterday.

tickets.title: SSO rejecting every attempt
tickets.description: Assertion errors on every login attempt across two workspaces.

records.scenario: supported restart — degraded service with a stall signature, no deployment

tickets.title: Sync workers wedged
tickets.description: Jobs enter running and never leave it. Queue depth climbing since about midday.

tickets.title: No warehouse rows since noon
tickets.description: Nothing has landed in our warehouse since around 12:40 and syncs never complete.

records.scenario: deployment present but unrelated — longstanding defect, healthy service

tickets.title: Scheduled export still truncates
tickets.description: Our nightly export has cut off at the same row count for months. Nothing changed recently on our side.

records.scenario: precedent-only — a past incident matches but no operational signal does

tickets.title: Dashboards look wrong
tickets.description: Some numbers seem off compared to last week. No errors on screen.

tickets.title: Dashboard figures a day stale
tickets.description: The freshness indicator says current but the numbers are yesterday's. The dashboards themselves load fine.

tickets.title: Connector seems unhappy
tickets.description: Hard to describe. Something is not right with it today.

records.scenario: contradictory evidence — reporters claim outage, health is fine

tickets.title: Analytics is completely down
tickets.description: Nothing works, the whole service must be offline.

tickets.title: Total outage on dashboards
tickets.description: Assuming everything is broken, nothing is usable.

records.scenario: invalid target — reporter names a version that does not exist

tickets.title: Roll back v99.12 immediately
tickets.description: Version 99.12 broke login for everyone. Roll it back now.

records.scenario: supported rollback with an off-pattern ticket alongside

tickets.title: Nobody can authenticate
tickets.description: Every sign-in attempt through the identity provider is rejected since this morning.

tickets.title: Profile photo upload failing
tickets.description: Unrelated to the login problem as far as I can tell, but reporting it anyway.

records.scenario: no service identified — no operational evidence at all

tickets.title: Things feel slow today
tickets.description: General sluggishness, no specific error, no particular page.
